lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur ma(n)tr avakhadh naam deenaa jan naanak sa(n)kat jon na paai ||5||2||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the medicine of the GurMantra, the Name of the Lord, O servant Nanak, does not suffer the agonies of reincarnation. ||5||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: re nar in bidh paar paraai ||
lines.translation: O man, in this way, you shall cross over to the other side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaai har jeeu hoi miratak tiaag doojaa bhaau || rahaau doojaa ||2||11||
lines.translation: Meditate on your Dear Lord, and be dead to the world; renounce your love of duality. ||Second Pause||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar dhoodhan te chhoot pare gur ghar hee maahi dikhaaiaa thaa ||
lines.translation: I have quit searching outside; the Guru has shown me that God is within the home of my own heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anabhau acharaj roop prabh pekhiaa meraa man chhod na katahoo jaaiaa thaa ||1||
lines.translation: I have seen God, fearless, of wondrous beauty; my mind shall never leave Him to go anywhere else. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanak paaio re paaio har pooraa paaiaa thaa ||
lines.translation: I have found the jewel; I have found the Perfect Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mol amol na paaiaa jaaee kar kirapaa guroo divaaiaa thaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The invaluable value cannot be obtained; in His Mercy, the Guru bestows it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: adisat agochar paarabraham mil saadhoo akath kathaaiaa thaa ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God is imperceptible and unfathomable; meeting the Holy Saint, I speak the Unspoken Speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਵਜਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anahad sabad dasam duaar vajio tah a(n)mrit naam chuaaiaa thaa ||2||
lines.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Naam trickles down there. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tot naahee man trisanaa boojhee akhut bha(n)daar samaaiaa thaa ||
lines.translation: I lack nothing; the thirsty desires of my mind are satisfied. The inexhaustible treasure has entered into my being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan charan charan gur seve aghaR ghaRio ras paaiaa thaa ||3||
lines.translation: I serve the feet, the feet, the feet of the Guru, and manage the unmanageable. I have found the juice, the sublime essence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje aavaa sahaje jaavaa sahaje man khelaaiaa thaa ||
lines.translation: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiaa taa har mahalee mahal paaiaa thaa ||4||3||12||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi saaj nivaajiaa tisahi siu ruch naahi ||
lines.translation: You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ ਬੋਈਐ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aan rootee aan boeeai phal na phoolai taahi ||1||
lines.translation: The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਜਣ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man vatr beejan naau ||
lines.translation: O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਇ ਖੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਭਲੋ ਸਮਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: boi khetee laai manooaa bhalo samau suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Focus your mind, and cultivate this crop; at the proper time, make this your purpose. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਇ ਖਹੜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoi khahaRaa bharam man kaa satigur saranee jaai ||
lines.translation: Eradicate the stubbornness and doubt of your mind, and go to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: karam jis kau dhurahu likhiaa soee kaar kamaai ||2||
lines.translation: He alone does such deeds, who has such pre-ordained karma. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਿਉ ਘਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau laagaa gobid siu ghaal paaee thaai ||
lines.translation: He falls in love with the Lord of the Universe, and his efforts are approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khet merai ja(n)miaa nikhut na kabahoo jaai ||3||
lines.translation: My crop has germinated, and it shall never be used up. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaiaa amol padaaratho chhod na katahoo jaai ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the priceless wealth, which shall never leave me or go anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sukh paaiaa tripat rahe aaghaai ||4||4||13||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have found peace; I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||4||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੂਟੋ ਆਂਡਾ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phooto aa(n)daa bharam kaa manahi bhaio paragaas ||
lines.translation: The egg of doubt has burst; my mind has been enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਪਗਹ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaatee beree pagah te gur keenee ba(n)d khalaas ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru has shattered the shackles on my feet, and has set me free. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan rahio ||
lines.translation: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪਤ ਕੜਾਹਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tapat kaRaahaa bujh gaiaa gur seetal naam deeo ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The boiling cauldron has cooled down; the Guru has blessed me with the cooling, soothing Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਗਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab te saadhoo sa(n)g bhaiaa tau chhod gae nigahaar ||
lines.translation: Since I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, those who were eyeing me have left.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਟਕ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਟਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis kee atak tis te chhutee tau kahaa karai kotavaar ||2||
lines.translation: The one who tied me up, has released me; what can the Watchman of Death do to me now? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੂਕਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chookaa bhaaraa karam kaa hoe nihakaramaa ||
lines.translation: The load of my karma has been removed, and I am now free of karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚੜੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saagar te ka(n)dhai chaRe gur keene dharamaa ||3||
lines.translation: I have crossed the world-ocean, and reached the other shore; the Guru has blessed me with this Dharma. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਠਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach thaan sach baithakaa sach suaau banaaiaa ||
lines.translation: True is my place, and True is my seat; I have made Truth my life's purpose.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sach poo(n)jee sach vakharo naanak ghar paaiaa ||4||5||14||
lines.translation: True is my capital, and True is the merchandise, which Nanak has placed into the home of the heart. ||4||5||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
